evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from other music discovery stories by its content-fingerprinting search method.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Music discovery based on the user's own profile is distinct from similar-user, content-similarity, and metadata mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Uses similar-user collaborative filtering for music discovery; while related to ZO-010, the explicit music search/discovery goal and user-initiated context distinguish it.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Specific content-similarity search for music/ringback from a music video; distinct from fingerprinting and metadata discovery.

evaluations.evidence: enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and tag-based discovery differs from profile, similar-user, fingerprint, and content-similarity mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Upload/tag ingestion step is not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Unique UI requirement for thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with ZO-009, which only narrows 'similar' to 'perceptually similar'; no meaningful actor, context, goal, permission, or business rule difference.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by ZO-008's general 'similar video items and segments' requirement; only adds the qualifier 'perceptually'.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: General content recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from the explicit music search/discovery story ZO-003; different domain/goal.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-based recommendation is unique.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is distinct from product, broadcaster logo, or brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from person, logo, or brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a specific object class and is not a duplicate of generic brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification differs from person, product, and broadcaster-logo identification despite some potential conceptual overlap.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-initiated video recommendation is unique.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Map-based geographic content access is unique.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is unique.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation QA/editing is distinct from annotation/topic extraction.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: News-segment annotation/topic extraction is distinct from segmentation editing.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is unique.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio edit pre-upload assessment is unique.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is unique.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset prefiltering is distinct from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering ZO-026.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is unique.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset prefiltering ZO-024.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Picture interestingness/complexity assessment is distinct from scientist-prompt detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist prompt detection is distinct from aesthetic assessment.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer type identification is unique.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo image preclassification is unique to its domain and task.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Same pattern as ZO-037 but in a different project/domain and target class; project context is a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Timestamping malfunction series detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti is distinct from Plankton species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal attribute preclassification is unique.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is unique in its project and modality.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is distinct from detection and classification stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Same pattern as ZO-031 but different project/domain/target; meaningful context difference.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Plankton size/orientation detection is distinct from species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is distinct from Snapshot Serengeti species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis is distinct from egg-laying detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying timing detection is distinct from motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc
evaluations.rationale: Satellite damage feature detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting is distinct from volunteer typing and project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact removal is distinct from transient object detection and other prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artifact removal.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is unique.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is a domain-specific clustering task distinct from generic subject grouping.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale count detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Intervention timing is distinct from intervention medium and education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Intervention medium is distinct from intervention timing.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is distinct from intervention timing and educational content/medium.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education medium is distinct from education timing.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Educational content selection is distinct from timing and medium.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting volunteer comments is distinct from Zoonibot commenting decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot comment timing is distinct from explanation timing and message content.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is distinct from general commenting and from what Zoonibot says.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot message content is distinct from timing decisions.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject similarity grouping is a distinct reusable capability from domain-specific grouping such as whale calls.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is distinct from volunteer classification weighting and content recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is unique.
